title: profile_scoped_preference_keys_test.dart tests each read* method twice under two differently-named, near-identical groups
why: For each of 7 read* methods (readAppLocale, readUseHebrewCalendar, readFontSizeIndex, readShowNikud, readLearningOrderParentControls, readHebrewTermsScript, readTransliterationVariant) the file has a 'ProfileScopedPreferenceKeys.readX' group immediately followed by a bare 'readX' group asserting the same scenarios (scoped value present, legacy-key fallback for profile 0, default when unset) via slightly different setup mechanics (setMockInitialValues vs. prefs.setString). None of the second groups add coverage the first doesn't already have -- this roughly doubles the file's length for no additional protection and doubles the edits needed whenever a read* method's fallback logic changes.
recommendation: Delete one of each duplicate group pair (keep whichever naming convention the rest of the suite uses); should shrink the file well under the AG-3 400-line threshold from the companion finding.
acceptance_criteria: File line count drops materially (each read* method has exactly one group) and dart test still exercises scoped/legacy/default paths for all 7 methods.
